status: PHUONG AN KHUYEN NGHI TRIEN KHAI - chua duoc nhom duyet; chua train; chua cham test

sample.main_sample: all 918 transitions of rq1_split_v2.csv (= y_eligible of pairs_audit.csv)

split.rationale: giu nguyen split, khong doi seed

algorithm: Linear Regression (OLS, khong phat), quyet dinh cua nhom

S1.fit: bo 6 dong dev co quality_flag_any khoi tap fit moi fold; baseline fit lai cung cach
S1.evaluation_rows: cung tap: 719 dong dev khong co co (so run chinh vs S1, ghep cap theo transition_id) + 6 dong co co bao rieng
S1.purpose: do nhay, khong chon cau hinh

S2.fit: chi dong dev open_prev>=1M cua cac fold con lai; baseline fit lai cung cach
S2.evaluation_rows: cung 725 dong dev (ca hai tang), du bao ngoai fold
S2.purpose: do nhay, khong chon cau hinh

phase_rules.task3_current: CHI chay tren dev (rq1_inputs_dev.csv, baseline_v2_dev_preds_wide.csv); khong doc rq1_inputs_test_LOCKED.csv; khong cham test
phase_rules.test_scoring: o task rieng sau khi khoa cau hinh (hash) va duoc nhom dong y

baseline_fit_set: tat ca dong dev cua cac fold con lai (da tai lap, sai lech <= 1.4e-15)
allowed_representation_changes: toi da 1 thay doi bieu dien/feature, chi dua tren do thi phan du tren dev (khong dua tren MAE), ghi nhat ky co thoi diem, ap dung dong nhat cho E1-E4

metrics.primary: MAE log gop (micro) tren du bao ngoai fold cua 725 dong dev
secondary: MAE tung fold + macro tb fold
MAE tb theo franchise (trung binh cua trung binh)
MAE theo tang open_prev kem n
AE diem phan tram (doi tung Y va Y_hat roi moi tinh; bao median va mean)
chenh lech ghep cap theo transition_id

selection_rule.gate_S1: MAE gop < E0 va MAE thap hon E0 o it nhat 3/4 fold
selection_rule.choose: trong nhom dat: MAE gop thap nhat; neu cau hinh phuc tap hon hon cau hinh don gian hon da dat < 0.005 log thi chon don gian (E1=E2 < E3 < E4); khong dat -> giu E0
selection_rule.claim_gate: chi noi hon mot baseline khi MAE gop thap hon va thap hon o >=3/4 fold so voi baseline do; bao rieng tung baseline
selection_rule.threshold_note: 0.005 la nguong thuc hanh khai bao truoc (khoang 40% khoang cach 0.013 giua cac baseline v2), khong phai kiem dinh thong ke

test_protocol: khoa design_config + split_assignment (hash) truoc khi cham; fit tren toan bo 725 dong dev; cham mot lan; baseline cung fit tren 725 dong dev
test_exposure_note: Y cua test da duoc mo ta o cap toan mau (Task 1); Task 2 khong dung test de ra quyet dinh
